scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('artifacts/web/dist/public')){fs.mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('artifacts/web/dist/public','build',{recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/public',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('artifacts/web/dist/public','dist/public',{recursive:true});}"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
